correctness.rationale: The inclusion graph between 2- and 3-subsets of a five-set has 20 vertices and 30 edges; its unordered two-particle deleted-product complex has (190,540,375) cells. Independent signed-boundary reconstruction gives connected C1 skeleton rank 189 and rank(d2 mod3)=340; eleven parked fundamental cycles establish rational upper bound 340, hence H1(Q)=11 and H2(Q)=35. The inspected checker explicitly verifies all 240 group-action differential equivariances, 14 character class values and Murnaghan–Nakayama Specht multiplicities. Central ± eigenspaces give H1 6+5 and H2 15+20; quotient invariants (1,6,15) for C2 and (1,0,0) for S5/full. Higher homology vanishes because cubical dimension two.
residual_risks: Modulo-three rank alone is only a rational lower bound; eleven parked graph cycles provide the separate upper bound.
No H1 integral torsion or full integral G-module split was claimed.
